fdc_description: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

disclosure: USDA values for one US brand of plain corn flakes (corn with malt flavouring); Indian brands differ a little, so your pack's label is exact.
USDA values for one Swiss-style muesli (oats, wheat, nuts, dried fruit, milk solids); brands differ, so your pack's label is exact.
USDA bulgur is parboiled cracked wheat; daliya is cracked wheat that is often not parboiled.
USDA besan is milled chickpeas; Indian besan is milled chana dal, the split desi chickpea.
